# Kazim Abbas — Portfolio

> Kazim Abbas (FedxD) is a backend and applied-AI engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan. Builds production systems in Python, Django, and PostgreSQL; ships voice-first and AI-driven interfaces.

## Projects
A curated list of 13 open-source projects. Each project has its own URL.
- [All Projects](https://fedxd.net/projects)

- [TeachBack](https://fedxd.net/projects/teachback) — A revolutionary learning platform where students learn by teaching AI
- [Skyntel](https://fedxd.net/projects/skyntel) — Interactive weather app with AI query support, personalized alerts, daily email subscriptions, and live weather reports from users
- [FinCore - Personal Finance & Islamic Wealth Management System](https://fedxd.net/projects/fincore) — A full-stack finance management application that helps users track income, expenses, and assets with upcoming Islamic financial principles integration (Khums & Zakat)
- [FedxD Data Container (FxDC)](https://fedxd.net/projects/fedxd-data-container-fxdc) — A lightweight, human-readable data serialization format for Python with native support for custom classes, type hints, and nested structures—cleaner than JSON, more Pythonic than YAML
- [FxPy - Custom Programming Language](https://fedxd.net/projects/fxpy) — A dynamically-typed, interpreted programming language built from scratch in Python with support for functions, control flow, modules, and comprehensive error reporting
- [FeXoBot - Feature-Rich Discord Bot](https://fedxd.net/projects/fexobot) — A comprehensive, multi-purpose Discord bot with 100+ commands, advanced moderation, interactive games, AI integration, and extensive API integrations for enhanced server management
- [FxQuest - Advanced Discord Gaming & Leveling Bot](https://fedxd.net/projects/fxquest) — A feature-rich Discord bot offering 8+ interactive games (UNO, Poker, Blackjack), economy system, XP-based leveling with role rewards, Minecraft-inspired mining mechanics, and comprehensive server management tools
- [Kazim Abbas - Portfolio Website](https://fedxd.net/projects/portfolio-website) — A modern, responsive portfolio website built with React 19, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion showcasing award-winning projects and professional experience
- [Full-Stack Web Application Template](https://fedxd.net/projects/fullstack-template) — A production-ready, containerized full-stack template featuring React 19, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Redis, and comprehensive JWT authentication with email verification
- [FedxD-PiPy](https://fedxd.net/projects/fedxd-pipy) — Quality of life Python package providing converters, utilities, and integrations for openpyxl, discord
- [FxChange](https://fedxd.net/projects/fxchange) — Demo stock and crypto exchange where users can trade with virtual currency, track portfolios, and grow their profiles
- [Webstore](https://fedxd.net/projects/webstore) — Complete e-commerce platform featuring inventory control, discounts, carts, and checkout systems with real-time calculations
- [VoiceMatter](https://fedxd.net/projects/voicematter) — Press-to-record Linux voice dictation daemon: Deepgram STT + Anthropic-compatible LLM formatter, with a frameless PySide6 overlay and auto-paste via ydotool
